# s2-server dashboards

Everything here is **provisioned from `/etc/nixos` (git)** — the JSON files are the source of truth. UI edits are temporary and vanish on the next provisioning sync; provisioned dashboards can't be deleted from the UI.

## Folders

| Folder | Contents |
|---|---|
| **System** | Host-level: Overview, CPU, Memory, Network, Security, Storage, GPU, Containers |
| **Services** | Self-hosted services: LiteLLM, Immich, Verdaccio, Postgres |
| **Media** | The tv/media pipeline (scraparr metrics) |
| **Apps** | Auto-generated per-app dashboards (`stacks/apps`) |
| **System** (alerts tab) | Provisioned alert rules live in the System folder |

## Adding a dashboard

In the owning stack's module:

```nix
myStack.grafanaDashboardsByFolder."<Folder>".<name> =
  builtins.readFile ./assets/dashboard.json;
```

Tag convention: `[<folder>, <subject>]`, title short (folder carries context).

*(This dashboard occupies a provisioning record that Grafana cannot drop — repurposed as documentation.)*
